remarks: Designed for easy living and effortless entertaining, this move-in ready home features a bright open floor plan, soaring ceiling height, and a stunning brand new kitchen that serves as the heart of the home. Filled with natural light, the fabulous sun room overlooks the expansive property and creates the perfect place to relax year-round. Set far back off Long Ridge Road, the home offers exceptional privacy and a peaceful setting while still being convenient to everything Stamford has to offer. The flexible layout includes an awesome lower recreation level and private guest suite, ideal for a playroom, home office, gym, or extended family living. A wonderful opportunity for first-time homebuyers, growing families, or anyone looking for space, comfort, and functionality in a beautiful setting.
